brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.

requirements.evidence: 4 full bases in row at q 0-3, each with bin:0-3,0,0~hex-bin-full-pvc full-depth planter bin filled with soil and planted

requirements.requirement: water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell
requirements.evidence: each cell has PVC-bore bin (hex-bin-full-pvc) with vertical riser riser:0,0,0 through riser:3,0,0 passing through the bore, providing continuous water pipe feed to all four cells

finish.summary: Built linear 4-cell planter; each cell fitted with full-depth PVC-bore bin filled and planted, with a riser/pipe through the bore in every cell to deliver water.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
